items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: We had Jimmy Archey, myself, Pops Foster, Mezzrow, Lee Collins...

ctx.x: Or you just happened to be in Chicago for a while?
Well, when I went to Jazz Limited the first time, that's when Sammy Price contacted me. I think we had one or two rehearsals here. We had Jimmy Archey, myself, Pops Foster, Mezzrow, Lee Collins...
